data.research_question: What defensible public location can be attached to ODNI, and what current evidence resolves the queued Jay Clayton DNI swearing-in target?
data.method: Enumerated 27 digs roots on current main. Excluded free-range (meta), dnc (previous hourly run), and wef-columbus (prior two hourly runs and Ohio/Columbus geography), leaving 24 eligible roots: canada-policy-influence, cia, cloarida, dark-academia, devil-corp, drunk-drivers, fed, flock, gop, graphika, greater-israel, hunter-biden, larry-fink, lexisnexis-risk-state-surveillance, occrp-aleph, offshore-leaks, palantir, tech-bro, trump-netanyahu, trump-thiel-circle, us-israel-military-integration, usaid-doge-mortality-accountability, violent-offenders, wef. Dataset seed 10847470863355715482 from SHA-256(main|2026-08-18T03:00:00Z|hourly-auto-dig|dataset-first-v1) selected fed uniformly at dataset stage. FED had two open queued targets; target seed 273761627213638376 selected starintel:target:fed:verify-clayton-dni-swearing-in. HQ phase preserved ODNI Washington, D.C. 20511 strictly as a postal locality. News phase ingested the August 3 swearing-in event after Senate/Reuters verification. Exact oath clock time remains unresolved. The connector cannot execute the full Free-Range loader, so the exact whole-corpus actionable-target total was not fabricated.

findings.finding: ODNI publishes Washington, D.C. 20511 for postal mail but no reviewed official street HQ.
The Senate confirmed Clayton on July 28, 2026 and he was sworn in August 3, 2026.
Exact oath clock time was not established.
